name: HTTP API Health Check
description: Make HTTP requests to check the health of an API endpoint, parse the response, and report status. Tests http_request and execute_code step types.
context_rules: Use HTTPS where possible. Report both HTTP status code and response body.

steps.name: Check primary endpoint
steps.description: Send a GET request to the health endpoint
steps.instruction: Send a GET request to {{health_url}} and confirm we get a 200 response

steps.name: Parse health response
steps.description: Parse the JSON response and extract key health metrics
steps.instruction: Parse the response from the previous health check step. Extract the status field and uptime from the JSON. Print a summary like 'Service: HEALTHY, Uptime: 99.9%'. If the response is not valid JSON, print 'INVALID RESPONSE'.

steps.name: Report health check failure
steps.description: The primary health check failed — report details
steps.instruction: Print 'HEALTH CHECK FAILED: The endpoint {{health_url}} returned a non-200 status or was unreachable.' and exit with code 1.

variables.name: health_url
variables.description: URL to check for health status
